# LLM Wiki — linked-data export

> Standards-based export of the compiled wiki graph — pages, typed edges with provenance labels, claims and citations — as JSON-LD and Turtle under mapping version 1.0.0. Corpus commit: a02b5394ba2cde30b72b0afc95e4d31513fcb3ac (working tree dirty).

## Artefacts

- [JSON-LD export](wiki.jsonld): the full graph with the context embedded.
- [Turtle export](wiki.ttl): the same triple set in RDF/Turtle.
- [JSON-LD context](context.jsonld): the versioned vocabulary mapping, published as its own artefact.
- [Export report](linked-data-report.json): counts, the full mapping table, the canonical SHA-256 of the triple set, and the loss report (every wiki construct with no mapping, by name and count).

## Claims (9)

- [Dieses Wiki existiert, um den Kontext des Agenten sichtbar in versionierten Dateien zu halten, statt im eigenen Gedächtnis des Agenten.](https://wikicitadel.example.org/claim/wiki/i18n/de/overview.md): stated on wiki/i18n/de/overview.md
- [決定が一括指示の対象になることは決してない。すべての決定には所有者自身の承認が必要である。](https://wikicitadel.example.org/claim/wiki/i18n/ja/decision-register.md): stated on wiki/i18n/ja/decision-register.md
- [このウィキは、エージェント自身の記憶の中ではなく、版管理されたファイルの中に、エージェントの文脈を目に見える形で保持するために存在する。](https://wikicitadel.example.org/claim/wiki/i18n/ja/overview.md): stated on wiki/i18n/ja/overview.md
- [결정은 포괄 지시의 대상이 되는 일이 결코 없다. 모든 결정에는 소유자 자신의 승인이 필요하다.](https://wikicitadel.example.org/claim/wiki/i18n/ko/decision-register.md): stated on wiki/i18n/ko/decision-register.md
- [이 위키는 에이전트 자신의 기억이 아니라, 버전이 관리되는 파일 안에 에이전트의 맥락을 눈에 보이게 보관하기 위해 존재한다.](https://wikicitadel.example.org/claim/wiki/i18n/ko/overview.md): stated on wiki/i18n/ko/overview.md
- [本维基的存在，是为了把智能体的上下文以可见的方式保存在受版本管理的文件中，而不是保存在智能体自身的记忆里。](https://wikicitadel.example.org/claim/wiki/i18n/zh/overview.md): stated on wiki/i18n/zh/overview.md
- [This wiki exists to hold the agent's context visibly, in versioned files, rather than in the agent's own memory.](https://wikicitadel.example.org/claim/wiki/overview.md): stated on wiki/overview.md
- [The founding note grants a blanket direction over work and reverses it for decisions in the same sitting.](https://wikicitadel.example.org/claim/wiki/sources/founding-note.md): stated on wiki/sources/founding-note.md
- [Decisions are never covered by the blanket direction; every decision needs the owner's own approval.](https://wikicitadel.example.org/claim/wiki/syntheses/decision-register.md): stated on wiki/syntheses/decision-register.md
